name: codie-root
description: CODIE - Real-time Collaborative Development & Live Teaching Environment

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server,piston -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix piston"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.prod: cross-env PISTON_URL=https://piston-4hy6.onrender.com concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run start --prefix client" "npm run start --prefix server"
scripts.prod:build: npm run build && npm run prod
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix piston
